## About
Plaza Collision is a collision center in the metro St. Louis area, part of the MileOne Autogroup family. Our shop is both I-CAR Gold Class Certified and certified by Audi, BMW, INFINITI, Lexus, Jaguar, Land Rover, Mercedes-Benz and Tesla.
Whether your car is brand new or an older model, and whether it was an accident or you just backed up a little too far in the garage, our technicians analyze the damage with care and repair it to factory standards and specs. We work on all domestic and foreign vehicles, with quality checks along the way and genuine OEM auto parts.
Reviewers rate us 4.4 from 384 Google reviews. One customer said Heather made it the best experience she had ever had with a collision center.

## Services
- Collision Repair: Repairs after an accident, done correctly and to the standards of your vehicle's brand, for domestic and foreign vehicles.
- Paint & Reconditioning: Scratches, chips, oxidation or damage from a minor dent. Our painters repair the area, prime and sand it, match the base coat with OEM technology, then apply the clear coat and check the finish. A single panel or the whole vehicle.
- Aluminum Repair: Aluminum responds differently to heat than steel and needs its own tools and a designated repair area. We have both, plus aluminum dent pullers that can save panels instead of replacing them.
- Paintless Dent Repair: For door dings, scratches and chips.
- Glass Replacement & Repair: For rocks, chips or cracks in your glass.
- Wheel Repair: For curbed, dented or cracked wheels.

## FAQ
Q: Can I get an estimate without bringing the car in?
A: Yes. The Plaza Collision Photo Estimator lets you send pictures of the damage from anywhere and get an estimate. From there we can arrange to pick up your vehicle or schedule an appointment.

Q: Do you work with insurance companies?
A: One reviewer said we work with all the major insurance companies, which took a lot of the headache out of the process for them.

Q: Is there a rental car available?
A: A reviewer noted there is an Enterprise car rental on site.

Q: What vehicles do you repair?
A: All domestic and foreign vehicles, from BMW, Mercedes, Lexus and Porsche to Toyota, Ford, Honda and Hyundai.

Q: Do you stand behind the repair?
A: One reviewer said we provide warranties and stand by our work.
